spans: THIS MEDIA LICENSE AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made and effective as of the date of the Closing (as defined in the Merger Agreement (as defined below)) (the "Effective Date"), between NATIONAL FOOTBALL MUSEUM, INC., an Ohio non-profit corporation, doing business as Pro Football Hall of Fame ("PFHOF"), HOF Village Media Group, LLC (the "Village Media Company"), a Delaware limited liability company that is a wholly-owned subsidiary of HOF Village, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("HOFV") and, solely for purposes of Section 4.5, HOFV; each a "Party" and collectively, the "Parties".
